checks.note: All Go packages, 350 platform tests, 22 legacy tests and contract drift checks pass. HTTP implementation coverage is 98/117; live PostgreSQL concurrency remains unverified.

Editor-only collection item moderation is revision-serialized and restricted to the immutable version/run owning an Apply output collection. Three live PostgreSQL media tests prove pending Apply versions stay gated and acceptance creates a claimable exact-origin derivative job.
Feedback validation/idempotency and sanitized Export.Get compile and pass focused tests; provenance migration passes on clean PostgreSQL in the 52-test database suite.

Live PostgreSQL covers four view/download/upload combinations, upload-only redaction, blind download-only all snapshot, selected denial, immediate policy revocation, multipart revoke-before-complete, and function-only portal role. Portal read/download URLs are capped at 60s; multipart PUT remains 600s.

Live PostgreSQL processes a 501-item bulk mutation as a 500-item committed chunk, preserves its ratings, then reports the remaining item as REVISION_CONFLICT after an external collection revision change; run and bulk finish completed_with_errors with a complete per-item report.

A disposable PostgreSQL database and isolated RabbitMQ vhost prove persistent collection.mutate routing through the production collection consumer, photo_worker SQL role, event fence, atomic rating mutation, terminal run/bulk state, ACK, and an empty queue.

decisions: Collection/item/section CRUD, publication, archive, share lifecycle, owner selection snapshots and durable bulk start/status/cancel are wired with tenant/project ACL, revision serialization, signed scoped cursors, exact artifact eligibility checks, audit and idempotency. Apply output item moderation locks the collection/item/version together, accepts only the version produced by the owning Apply run, synchronizes item/version state and leaves visibility hidden until explicit publication. Asset list/get/delete, tenant event filtering, immutable source-hash-bound overrides and per-user editor drafts are connected. Bulk requests freeze strict action params and an exact user snapshot into a linked bulk run. Durable retry_media uses exact outbox intake, leased deterministic materialization and canonical fenced derivative adoption. Live PostgreSQL covers bulk replay, forged-event refusal, ingest and accepted-Apply origins.

Training.AddFeedback requires explicit consent, exact draft training revision, same-project collection membership and verifiable source lineage. Generated results are marked user_added_generated. Export.Get exposes readiness and bounded metadata without storage identity.

Migration00168 fixes A19: download-only links expose a blind all-download capability and may create only scope=all snapshots; catalog, sections, cover, selected/filter and item metadata stay view-gated. It also makes pgcrypto explicit, qualifies digest in SECURITY DEFINER functions and repairs begin_portal_upload column ambiguity found by live execution.

BULK01 has a live PostgreSQL revision-fence proof: chunk one commits exactly 500 successes and advances both collection and expected revisions; a conflicting external revision before chunk two preserves those effects and records the sole remaining item as REVISION_CONFLICT. Rabbit publisher/consumer delivery remains covered separately and is not claimed by this SQL execution test.

The collection worker transport is live-verified end to end in an isolated RabbitMQ vhost: production topology routes collection.mutate, RunWorker consumes with prefetch one, executes the event-fenced PostgreSQL function under photo_worker, acknowledges only after commit, and shuts down cleanly.
